DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご相談の用件を、簡単にお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you briefly tell me what you would like advice about?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この欄に工場と書きましたが、働いている場所だけでは相談内容が分かりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 相談内容に職種だけ書いたと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I wrote ‘factory’ in this box, but just saying where I work doesn't explain what I need advice about, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you only wrote your type of work as the reason for your consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 工場のお仕事で、どんなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: What difficulty are you having with your factory job?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 来月から開始が一時間早くなると言われました。子どもを保育園へ送る時刻と重なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 勤務変更による保育送迎の困り事を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've been told that our starting time will be an hour earlier from next month. That overlaps with the time I take my child to nursery school.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain your difficulty taking your child to nursery school because of the change in working hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 会社からの案内と、ご本人のご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please show me the company's notice and tell me what you would prefer.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 変更すると言われた紙はこちらです。私は元の開始時刻を希望していますが、会社へはまだ返事をしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会社決定と本人希望を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here is the paper saying the time will change. I would prefer the original starting time, but I haven't replied to the company yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish the company's decision from your own preference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 相談で、まず何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: What would you like to clarify first during your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 会社へ事情を伝える時、開始時刻について何を質問しておくとよいかを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 相談で確かめたい質問を一つに絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like advice on what I should ask about the starting time when I explain my circumstances to the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Narrow down the question you want to clarify during the consultation to one point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その質問を担当へおつなぎします。契約の資料もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll refer that question to the person in charge. Please also bring your contract documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 用件欄を勤務開始の変更と送迎の相談に直します。会社の紙と契約を示し、返答前に質問の整理をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 用件欄を具体的に直して担当へ出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll change the reason for my visit to advice about the change in starting time and taking my child to nursery school. I'll show the company's paper and my contract, and ask for help organizing my questions before I reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Make the reason for your visit more specific and submit it to the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その内容で受け付けました。資料をそろえて相談席へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've registered your visit with that information. Please gather your documents and go to the consultation desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乾燥機の表示についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is your question about the dryer display?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もうすぐ終わると思ったのに、残りが四十分になっています。私の分に時間が足されたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 乾燥時間が急に長くなったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought it was almost finished, but now it says forty minutes remaining. Has time been added to my load?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about the drying time suddenly becoming longer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お使いの機械の番号を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Can you check the number of the machine you are using?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 最初に撮った写真では六番です。今見ていたのは七番でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 使用番号の写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The photo I took at the start shows number six. The one I was just looking at was number seven.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the photo of the number of your machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 六番はこちらです。七番は別のお客様のご利用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Number six is over here. Number seven is being used by another customer.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 隣の表示を見ていました。七番には触らず、六番の残り五分を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 隣機の表示を見ていたと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I was looking at the display on the next machine. I won't touch number seven, and I'll check the five minutes remaining on number six.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you were looking at the next machine's display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乾き具合は終了後に確認してください。追加する時も衣類の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please check how dry your clothes are after the cycle finishes. If you add more time, check the care labels as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乾燥し過ぎたくない衣類があります。まず取り出して状態を見てから、追加する物だけ分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分の機械の追加時間が必要か衣類表示で考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Some of my clothes mustn't be dried too much. I'll take them out and check their condition first, then separate only the items that need more drying.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Consider whether your load needs more drying time by checking the clothing labels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 終了前に扉を開けず、機械の案内に沿ってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please don't open the door before the cycle finishes. Follow the instructions on the machine while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 六番が終わったら自分の物だけ出します。写真の番号を見て、次も隣の機械と間違えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 自分の機械だけ終了後に取り出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Once number six finishes, I'll take out only my own things. I'll check the number in my photo so I don't mistake it for the next machine again.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Take out only your own laundry from your machine after it finishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 六番の終了をお待ちください。衣類と、ご使用のかごを忘れずにお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please wait for number six to finish. Remember to take your clothes and the basket you used home with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 追加のご注文でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like to order something else?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先ほど頼んだ肉が来ていないので、同じ物をもう二皿お願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 追加した肉が来ていないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The meat I ordered earlier hasn't arrived, so I'd like another two plates of the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about the additional meat that you think has not arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お手元の皿と注文の記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check the plates on your table and your order record.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この皿は最初の注文と思っていました。札には追加で頼んだ方の名前がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 卓上皿の注文名を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought this plate was from our first order. The label has the name of the meat we ordered later, doesn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the name of the order on the plate on your table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その皿が追加分です。まだ焼いていないため、残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: That plate is your additional order. It's still here because you haven't grilled it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 来ていないのではなく、焼く前の肉だったんですね。二皿を追加する前に量を考え直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未提供ではなく未焼成の肉と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: So it wasn't missing; it was meat we hadn't grilled yet. I'd like to reconsider the amount before adding two more plates.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the meat has been served but has not been grilled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今の追加はまだ通していません。必要な分をご指定ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I haven't put through that additional order yet. Please tell me how much you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 卓上の分を食べてからにしたいですが、友人用に別の肉を一皿だけ頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 現在の量を見て追加を減らしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to finish what's on the table first, but could we order just one plate of a different meat for my friend?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Look at the amount you already have and ask to reduce the additional order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そちらのお肉一皿ですね。種類はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: One plate of that meat, then. Is this the variety you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。既に来た皿は焼いて食べ、新しい追加はこの種類一皿だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 既提供分を焼き追加一皿だけ注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes. We'll grill and eat the plates that have already arrived, and the only new addition will be one plate of this variety.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will grill the meat already served and order only one additional plate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 追加はこの一皿で承りました。先ほどの同じ肉二皿は注文に入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've taken your order for just this one additional plate. I haven't ordered the two plates of the same meat you mentioned earlier.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 現在お使いのお薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you currently taking any medication?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 海外で買った薬を昨日飲みました。名前を日本語で読めないので、この箱の写真を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 海外の薬名が読めず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I took some medicine I bought overseas yesterday. I can't read its name in Japanese, so I'd like you to look at this photo of the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot read the name of medicine from overseas and ask for help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 飲んだ時刻や量は、覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you remember what time you took it and how much?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 昨夜九時ごろ、一錠です。箱の表だけを撮ったので、成分の所は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 服用時刻と数量を分かる範囲で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I took one tablet at about nine last night. I only photographed the front of the box, so I don't know about the ingredients section.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give the time and amount you took as far as you know. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 成分や説明が写った資料があれば、診療担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: If you have anything showing the ingredients or instructions, please show it to the medical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 箱は家族が持っています。裏面を撮って送ってもらい、この表の写真と一緒に出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 外箱写真に成分欄がないと気付く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: My family has the box. I'll ask them to photograph the back and send it, then submit it with this photo of the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Notice that the photo of the outer box does not show the ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご家族へ連絡できますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真が届きました。こちらが裏です。似た箱の別の薬ではないかも、家族に確かめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 家族へ裏面写真を依頼して資料を補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: The photo has arrived. This is the back. I also checked with my family that it wasn't a different medicine in a similar box.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask your family for a photo of the back to provide the missing information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その資料をお預かりして担当へ伝えます。受付だけで薬の内容を確定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll take this information and pass it to the medical staff. Reception alone cannot determine exactly what the medicine is.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。薬名は未確認として、昨夜一錠飲んだことと両方の画像を診察で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 薬を特定したと断言せず両画像を診療担当へ出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I understand. I'll explain during my consultation that the medicine's name is unconfirmed, that I took one tablet last night, and show both images.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Submit both images to the medical staff without claiming that the medicine has been identified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 服用の情報と画像を担当へ申し送りました。呼出しまで資料をお手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've passed the details of what you took and the images to the medical staff. Please keep the information with you until you are called.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: タオルについてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is your question about the towels?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二枚受け取りました。使った後は、どちらも持って帰ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二枚のタオルをどちらも持帰れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I received two towels. May I take both of them home after using them?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can take both towels home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お買い上げと貸出しの控えを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's check the receipt for the purchase and rental.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小さい一枚は購入、もう一枚は貸出しと書いてあります。同じ受付だったので全部買ったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 借用一枚と購入一枚の控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: It says I purchased the small one and rented the other one. Because I got them at the same counter, I thought I had bought both.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the receipt indicating one rented towel and one purchased towel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 貸出しの方は返却が必要です。こちらに貸出し用の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The rented one must be returned. It has a rental marking here.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この表示のある方ですね。色だけで決めず、表示を見て分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 色だけでなく表示で借用品を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: You mean the one with this marking. I'll separate them by checking the markings, rather than just the colors.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Identify the rented towel by its marking as well as its color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。購入された方はお持ち帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. You may take the one you purchased home.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 借りた方は、使用後どこへ返しますか。受付へ濡れたまま渡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 使用後の返却場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Where should I return the rented one after using it? Is it all right to hand it to reception while it's wet?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask where to return the towel after using it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの返却かごへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please put it in this return basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 借りた方をかごへ返しました。購入した一枚だけを自分の袋へ入れて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 借用品を返し購入分だけ荷物へ入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've returned the rented one to the basket. I'll put only the towel I bought into my own bag and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Return the rented towel and put only the purchased one in your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 貸出し分の返却を確認しました。お忘れ物を確認してお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've confirmed the return of the rented towel. Please check that you haven't left anything behind before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 花束のご予約を伺います。お受取りはいつでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to take your bouquet reservation. When would you like to collect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 金曜日に受け取りたいです。土曜日の昼に、友人へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 贈る前日に花束を受取る予約を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to collect it on Friday. I'll give it to my friend at noon on Saturday.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about reserving a bouquet for collection the day before you give it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 贈る前日にお受取りになるのですね。保管する場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: So you'll collect it the day before giving it. Do you have somewhere to keep it?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 自宅に置くつもりですが、日が当たる部屋しかありません。受け取ってからの置き方を考えていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 贈呈日と受取希望日を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I was planning to keep it at home, but I only have a room that gets direct sunlight. I hadn't thought about where to put it after collection.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish the day you will give the bouquet from your preferred collection day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 置き場所や移動時間も含め、受取日をご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please consider the storage location and travel time when deciding your collection day.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 土曜の朝なら、受け取ってすぐ渡せます。予約を土曜日の十時に変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自宅で保管場所を確保できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: If I collect it on Saturday morning, I can give it to my friend straight away. Could I change the reservation to ten on Saturday?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot arrange a suitable place to store it at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その時刻に準備できるか確認します。花束の内容は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check whether we can have it ready at that time. Will the bouquet itself be the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 内容は同じです。付けるカードは、おめでとうではなく、ありがとうにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 贈呈当日の受取へ変更可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, the bouquet will be the same. I'd like the card to say ‘Thank you’ instead of ‘Congratulations.’
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can change collection to the day you give the bouquet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 土曜十時でご用意できます。カードもありがとうに直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can have it ready at ten on Saturday. We'll change the card to ‘Thank you’ as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 土曜十時に受け取って、そのまま友人の所へ行きます。カードはありがとうでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 変更後の日時とカード文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll collect it at ten on Saturday and go straight to my friend's place. Please make the card say ‘Thank you.’
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm the revised date, time, and card message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 受取日と時刻、カードの変更で承りました。この控えを当日お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've accepted the changes to the collection day, time, and card. Please bring this receipt on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 給与の資料を整理されているのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You're organizing your salary documents, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三月分の明細と、四月の入金履歴があります。月が違うので、別々の収入として書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同じ給与の明細と翌月入金をどう示すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have my payslip for March and my bank deposit record for April. Since they are different months, may I list them as separate income?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask how to show a payslip and the deposit of the same salary in the following month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それぞれの対象と支払日が分かる資料を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's look at the documents that show what each payment covers and the payment date.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 明細は三月に働いた分で、振込日は四月五日です。会社の説明では、その給与の入金です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 勤務対象月と入金日を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The payslip is for the work I did in March, and the transfer date is April fifth. The company says this deposit is for that salary.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State the month you worked and the deposit date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 勤務した月と入金した月が違うことを、担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please explain to the person in charge that the month you worked and the month the money arrived are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ給与なのに二つ足したメモを作っていました。その計算は未確認として出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二件分として足したメモの誤りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I had made a note adding the two together even though they're the same salary. I'd like to submit that calculation as unverified.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the mistake in your note that added them as two separate payments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 対応する明細と入金履歴を、別の収入と決めずに示しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Show the corresponding payslip and deposit record without deciding that they are separate income.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ番号を二つの資料に付けて、明細一枚と履歴の一行を対にして見せてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 対応を確かめる資料の提示方法を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: May I put the same number on both documents and show one payslip paired with one line of the deposit record?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask how to present documents so their correspondence can be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご自分の整理として印を付け、元の資料も残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You may mark them for your own organization, but please keep the original documents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 元の資料を持参します。対象月、支払日、同じ給与という会社の説明を示して、記入する金額は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 金額を自己計算せず明細と履歴を対にして相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll bring the original documents. I'll show the month worked, the payment date, and the company's explanation that they're the same salary, and check with the person in charge what amount to enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Pair the payslip with the deposit record and ask for advice instead of calculating the amount yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その資料の対応で相談できます。計算したメモも、未確認と分かるよう添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KAWAGUCHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: You can consult us using the documents paired that way. Please attach your calculation note marked clearly as unverified as well.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 返品についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about returning an item?

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この服は二千円だったので、二千円を現金で返してもらえると思いました。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入額全額を現金で返してもらうと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This garment cost two thousand yen, so I thought I would get two thousand yen back in cash.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you expected the full purchase price to be refunded in cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず購入時のお支払いを確認します。レシートにはポイント利用とありますね。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's check how you paid. The receipt says you used points.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五百円分をポイント、残り千五百円を現金で払いました。全部を現金で払ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ポイント五百円分と現金千五百円の支払内訳を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I paid five hundred yen's worth in points and the remaining fifteen hundred yen in cash. I didn't pay the whole amount in cash.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the payment breakdown to five hundred yen in points and fifteen hundred yen in cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返品の可否と、受け付けた場合の返し方を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check whether we can accept the return and how we would refund it if we do.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金二千円が戻ると決めずに説明を聞きます。ポイント分の扱いも、現金とは別に教えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返品可否と返し方の説明を求めポイント扱いも別に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll listen to your explanation without assuming I'll get two thousand yen in cash. Please also explain separately how the points portion will be handled.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the return is possible and how the refund works, including a separate explanation of the points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。購入時に使用した会員の画面はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the person in charge. Do you have the membership screen you used for the purchase?

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この会員画面です。残高だけで返却済みとは判断せず、この購入の記録で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会員画面を示し残高だけでなく該当購入記録で確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, here it is. I'd like to check the record for this purchase, rather than assume the refund has been made just from the balance.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your membership screen and ask to check the particular purchase record rather than just the balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: レシートと会員の記録を照合してご案内します。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll compare the receipt with the membership record and explain the result.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。返品が受け付けられるかを先に確認し、現金分とポイント分の結果をそれぞれ聞いてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返品受付と現金分ポイント分の各結果を確認してから帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll first check whether the return is accepted, then hear the results for the cash portion and points portion separately before I leave.
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm acceptance of the return and the separate results for cash and points before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品、レシート、お支払いの内訳を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will check the item, receipt, and breakdown of your payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらがお飲み物二つです。

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子どもが欲しがっているので、このカップを渡してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 子どもへ渡すカップを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. My child wants a drink. May I give them this cup?
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check which cup to give your child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらは大人の方のコーヒーです。まだ熱いのでご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: This is the adult's coffee. Please be careful, as it is still hot.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ふたが同じなので、子どもの飲み物と思いました。まだ渡していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 似たふたで取り違えたが未手渡しだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The lids look the same, so I thought it was my child's drink. I haven't handed it over yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that the similar lids caused a mix-up, but you have not handed over the drink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もう一方がご注文のりんごジュースです。容器の表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The other one is the apple juice you ordered. Please check the label on the container as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表示はここですね。コーヒーを子どもの席から離して置きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 表示を見て大人の飲料を離して置きたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The label is here, isn't it? I'd like to put the coffee away from my child's seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the label and say you want to place the adult's drink farther away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの安定した位置へ置けます。テーブルの端は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can put it in this stable spot. Please avoid the edge of the table.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ジュースのふたを開けるのは私がします。飲む前に中身を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 親が開けて飲む前に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll open the juice lid myself. I'll check what's inside before my child drinks it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that the parent will open it and check before the child drinks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。お子さんにも、こちらが自分の飲み物だとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Please also tell your child which drink is theirs.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: りんごジュースと確認できました。コーヒーは私の側に置き、二つを取り違えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 二つの中身と置き場所を区別して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've confirmed that this is apple juice. I'll keep the coffee on my side so we don't mix the two up.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Distinguish and confirm the contents and placement of the two drinks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その置き方でどうぞ。必要なものがあればお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: That arrangement is fine. Please let us know if you need anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like advice about getting a spare key made?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家の鍵を一本増やしたいです。この二本のうち、どちらを渡せばよいか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二本のうち家の鍵を複製したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like one more copy of my house key. I wasn't sure which of these two keys to give you.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to have the house key among your two keys copied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お客様ご自身でも、用途が分からない状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you yourself unsure which key is for what?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 形が似ていて、片方は自転車の鍵です。家族が付けた印を見れば分かるはずです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 似た形で本人も用途不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: They look similar, and one is a bicycle key. I should be able to tell by the mark my family put on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that the similar shapes mean you are unsure what each key is for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先に用途をご確認ください。確認してから、作製できる種類か調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please confirm what it's for first. Once you have, we'll check whether it is a type we can copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家族へ聞くと、青い印が家用でした。もう一本は自転車で、増やす必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 使用時の印を家族へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I asked my family, and the one with the blue mark is for the house. The other one is for the bicycle, and I don't need another copy of that.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check with your family which identifying mark is on the key you use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 青い印の一本を拝見します。ご希望の本数は一本ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let me see the one with the blue mark. You'd like one additional key, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。この家用だけです。今の種類がここで作れるか、先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 家用と確認した一本だけの対応可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, just this house key. Please check first whether you can copy this type here.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the shop can copy only the key you have confirmed is for your house. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 担当が種類と受付条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The person in charge will check the type and the conditions for accepting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 家用一本の相談としてお願いします。自転車の鍵は渡さず、自分の袋へ戻しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 種類確認の受付を頼み別鍵は持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please handle this as an inquiry about one house key. I haven't handed over the bicycle key; I've put it back in my own bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the type, and keep the other key to take home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 用途を確認した一本を担当へお預かりしました。作製の可否と条件をご案内するまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SIT-KOSHIGAYA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've given the person in charge the one key whose purpose you've confirmed. Please wait while we check whether it can be copied and under what conditions.
